typography.rationale: Manrope provides a grounded, stable, and slightly rounded geometric feel perfect for a business tool that needs to feel human. Work Sans ensures impeccable legibility in dense data tables and mobile lists. Avoids generic Inter/Roboto entirely.

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] for all interactive elements

bottom_nav.layout: Fixed bottom, full width, flex justify-around items-center min-h-[64px] pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]
bottom_nav.keyboard_behavior: Must be hidden when virtual keyboard is active (use CSS media queries or React visualViewport listeners)
bottom_nav.more_tab: The 5th tab must be 'More' with a Hamburger/Menu icon that opens a slide-up Shadcn Drawer for the remaining modules.

cards.kpi_card: bg-[#141C1C] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between
cards.list_card: bg-[#141C1C] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-white/5 shadow-sm

forms_and_lists.row_item: flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-white/5 last:border-b-0 min-h-[56px] active:bg-[#1E2929] transition-colors
forms_and_lists.input_field: w-full bg-[#1E2929] text-[#F8FAFA] placeholder:text-[#687777] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 min-h-[48px] focus:border-[#2B8A8F] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2B8A8F]

tabs_segmented_control.container: bg-[#0B1010] p-1 rounded-xl flex border border-white/5
tabs_segmented_control.tab: flex-1 text-center py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center

pro_badge.design: bg-[#2B8A8F]/15 border border-[#2B8A8F]/30 text-[#45A7AC] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1
pro_badge.icon: Requires a small glowing star or root icon next to the text.

motion.drawer_slide: Framer motion slide up from 100% to 0% with spring stiffness 300 damping 30

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a mobile-first PWA. All pages must be constrained to typical mobile widths on desktop (max-w-md mx-auto) or elegantly expand into a tablet view.
Ensure lucide-react is installed for all icons. Use filled icons for active nav states and outline for inactive.
Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, list items) to facilitate testing.
For 'Finance & Clients', implement a horizontal scrollable segmented control or a sticky sub-header with tabs, since it has 8 sub-modules.
Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for the Dashboard pie and bar charts, mapping to the 10+ chart colors array provided.
Ensure strictly no 'pure' #000000 black. Always use the specified #0B1010 to maintain the 'grounded' earthy tint.
Do NOT use HTML native components for dropdowns/calendars, use heavily customized Shadcn components matching the dark theme.
